}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

// poses (optional): oni.timeline spec.poses, e.g. { c: { dl: { prop: 'sprite_standard' } } }.

async function boot(extra, poses) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, poses: poses || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// ── 8-direction spin (the walk-map standing art) ──

// The five drawn standing slots, all drawn facing LEFT; the three right-hand views are mirrors.

K.SPIN8_POSES = { dl: { prop: 'sprite_standard' }, d: { prop: 'sprite_stand_down' }, l: { prop: 'sprite_stand_left' }, ul: { prop: 'sprite_stand_up_left' }, u: { prop: 'sprite_stand_up' } };

// Opaque rows of an image (alpha > 128) as fractions of its height, or null (unreadable).

K.bodyBox = (img) => {

try {

const W = img.naturalWidth || img.videoWidth || img.width, H = img.naturalHeight || img.videoHeight || img.height; if (!W || !H) return null;

const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = W; cv.height = H; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, W, H).data; let top = -1, bot = -1;

for (let y = 0; y < H && top < 0; y++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) if (d[(y * W + i) * 4 + 3] > 128) { top = y; break; }

for (let y = H - 1; y >= 0 && bot < 0; y--) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) if (d[(y * W + i) * 4 + 3] > 128) { bot = y + 1; break; }

return top < 0 ? null : { top: top / H, bot: bot / H };

} catch (e) { return null; }

};

// After boot(_, { k: K.SPIN8_POSES }): true when all five slots loaded for token k. Re-sizes

// every slot by ONE scale (the standing body height matched to the battle art's body height)

// and gives each slot its own feet line, so no frame jumps against another.

K.spin8Ready = (tl, k) => {

const P = tl.POSE[k]; if (!P) return false;

for (const s of ['dl', 'd', 'l', 'ul', 'u']) if (!P[s] || !P[s].img) return false;

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// See you later — approved mockup (v8, round 2: the comedic exit). Shared by Zarg and

// Keren (the caster is whoever uses it).

// 0 "See ya!" bubble (the only text any party shot draws)

// 650 Wind4; a short wind-up crouch toward the enemy (160 ms)

// 810 backward dash off the screen edge on the party side (420 ms ease-in, running

// bob, motion blur to 3 px), speed lines + a GG dashsmoke kick at the feet

// 1230 gone — a beat of empty space

// 1480 Wind1; a gust of leaves blows in from the edge they left by, across their

// spot: drag bleeds the wind, gravity vs air drag gives a slow fall, pendulum

// sway, spin and a 3D flip; they settle on the feet line and fade

// The caster is NOT drawn again (BD removes the token after the shot).

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, U, E } = B;

const t = cfg.t;

const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

const side = -dir; // the dash direction: away from the enemy

const C = TOK.c; const cf = K.feet(tl, 'c'); const art = tl.art('c');

// the frame edge on the party side, in scene px (where the camera rests for this shot)

let edge;

try { const v = tl.camView({ cam: { cx: tl.REST.cx, cy: tl.REST.cy, zoom: 1 }, panY: 0 }); edge = side > 0 ? v.right : v.left; } catch (e) { edge = null; }

if (edge == null || !isFinite(edge)) edge = side > 0 ? tl.SCENE.x + tl.SCENE.w : tl.SCENE.x;

if ((edge - cf.x) * side < 200 * U) edge = cf.x + side * 200 * U;

const exitDx = edge + side * (C.w / 2 + 70 * U) - cf.x;

// ── "See ya!" bubble: pops from .2 to 1.1 (260 ms), holds 700, fades 250 ──

const head = { x: cf.x + side * 20 * U, y: cf.y - C.h * 0.95 - 10 * U };

m.hold(0, 1210, (e, S) => {

const s = e < 260 ? 0.2 + 0.9 * E.outQ(e / 260) : 1.1;

const a = e < 960 ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (e - 960) / 250);

S.world.push({ z: 80, draw: (g) => {

const fs = 30 * U; g.save(); g.font = '700 ' + fs + 'px Signika, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif';

const tw = g.measureText('See ya!').width; const bw = tw + 24 * U + 6 * U, bh = fs + 8 * U + 6 * U;

g.translate(head.x, head.y - bh / 2); g.scale(s, s); g.globalAlpha = a;

g.beginPath(); if (g.roundRect) g.roundRect(-bw / 2 + 1.5 * U, -bh / 2 + 1.5 * U, bw - 3 * U, bh - 3 * U, 15 * U); else g.rect(-bw / 2, -bh / 2, bw, bh);

g.fillStyle = '#c0392b'; g.fill(); g.lineWidth = 3 * U; g.strokeStyle = '#2a1a0e'; g.stroke();

g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle'; g.fillText('See ya!', 0, 0.5 * U);

g.restore();

} });

});

// ── wind-up crouch (real token) ──

m.hold(t.crouch, t.dash, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok.c; if (!q) return; const u = E.outQ(Math.min(1, e / (t.dash - t.crouch))); q.dx += dir * 10 * U * u; q.dy += 4 * U * u; });

// ── the dash: painted from his own texture with motion blur; hidden from here to the end ──

const DASH = t.gone - t.dash;

m.hold(t.dash, 1e9, (e, S) => {

if (S.tok.c) S.tok.c.hidden = true;

if (e >= DASH || !art) return;

const u = E.inQ(e / DASH);

const dx = dir * 10 * U + (exitDx - dir * 10 * U) * u;

const dy = 4 * U * (1 - u) - Math.abs(Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 6)) * 8 * U;

S.world.push({ z: 20, draw: (g) => { g.save(); g.translate(cf.x + dx, cf.y + dy); g.scale(C.flip, 1); g.filter = 'blur(' + (u * 3 * U).toFixed(2) + 'px)'; g.drawImage(art, -C.w / 2, -C.h * C.foot, C.w, C.h); g.restore(); } });

});

// dust kick at the feet where he pushes off

m.clip('dashsmoke', t.dash, { x: cf.x + dir * 10 * U, y: cf.y + 4 * U - 8 * U, w: 1024 * 0.85 * 0.5 * U, z: 40, flip: side > 0, filter: 'brightness(.95)' });

// speed lines: 10 white streaks over his height, sliding 900 px the way he runs

{

const r = tl.rng(31); const LM = 520; const top = cf.y + 4 * U - C.h, bot = cf.y + 4 * U; const L = [];

for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) L.push({ y: top + r() * (bot - top), w: (160 + r() * 220) * U, h: (2 + r() * 2) * U, x0: (-265 + r() * 400) * U, d: r() * LM * 0.4 });

m.hold(t.dash, t.dash + LM, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 56, draw: (g) => {

g.save(); g.lineCap = 'round';

for (const l of L) {

const k = (e - l.d) / (LM * 0.6); if (k < 0 || k > 1) continue;

const xl = l.x0 + 900 * U * k; const xa = cf.x + side * xl, xb = cf.x + side * (xl + l.w);

const gr = g.createLinearGradient(xa, 0, xb, 0); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)');

g.globalAlpha = Math.sin(k * Math.PI); g.strokeStyle = gr; g.lineWidth = l.h; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(xa, l.y); g.lineTo(xb, l.y); g.stroke();

}

g.restore();

} }));

}

// ── the leaf gust (mockup leafGust/leafFrame physics, pre-simulated at 60 Hz) ──

// The mockup's gust started 435 px from the spot; horizontal speeds are scaled so it

// crosses THIS spot from THIS edge (KX), everything vertical scales with U.

const DT = 1 / 60, STEP = 1000 / 60;

const fromX = edge + side * 18 * U;

const KX = Math.max(0.5, Math.abs(fromX - cf.x) / 435);

const COLS = ['#6f9a3a', '#8fb04a', '#b98a2e', '#c8692c', '#5d8a35', '#a7a241'];

const LEAVES = [];

{

const r = tl.rng(57); const gb = cf.y, gy0 = gb - C.h * 0.9, gy1 = gb - 10 * U;

for (let i = 0; i < (cfg.leaves || 14); i++) {

const s = (10 + r() * 9) * U;

const l = { x: fromX + side * r() * 120 * U, y: gy0 + r() * (gy1 - gy0), vx: -side * (520 + r() * 380) * KX, vy: (-40 + r() * 60) * U,

rot: r() * 6, spin: (r() - 0.5) * 5, sw: 2 + r() * 2, ph: r() * 6, flip: 3 + r() * 4, floor: gb - r() * 30 * U, age: -i * 0.05, landed: 0, fade: 1 };

const fr = [];

for (let n = 0; n < 60 * 14 && l.fade > 0; n++) {

l.age += DT;

if (!l.landed) {

l.vx += (-l.vx) * 1.6 * DT;

l.vy += (60 * U - l.vy * 1.8) * DT;

l.x += (l.vx + Math.sin(l.age * l.sw + l.ph) * 38 * U) * DT;

l.y += (l.vy + Math.cos(l.age * l.sw * 2 + l.ph) * 12 * U) * DT;

l.rot += (l.spin + Math.sin(l.age * l.sw + l.ph) * 2) * DT;

if (l.y >= l.floor) { l.y = l.floor; l.landed = l.age || 0.001; }

} else if (l.age - l.landed > 1.4) l.fade = Math.max(0, 1 - (l.age - l.landed - 1.4) / 0.8);

fr.push([l.x, l.y, l.rot, l.landed ? 0.35 : Math.cos(l.age * l.flip + l.ph), l.fade]);

}

LEAVES.push({ s, col: COLS[i % COLS.length], fr });

}

}

let leafMs = 0; for (const l of LEAVES) leafMs = Math.max(leafMs, l.fr.length * STEP);

leafMs = Math.min(leafMs, cfg.leafCapMs || 8000);

const total = t.gust + leafMs;

const leaf = (g, x, y, rot, fl, a, s, col) => {

const w = s * 1.6, h = s;

g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(rot); g.scale(fl, 1); g.globalAlpha = a;

// border-radius 0 100% 0 100%: two opposite corners rounded fully

g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(-w / 2, h / 2, w, h, 0, -Math.PI / 2, 0); g.ellipse(w / 2, -h / 2, w, h, 0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI); g.closePath();

g.fillStyle = col; g.fill();

g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.5 * U); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-w / 2, -h / 2); g.lineTo(w / 2, h / 2); g.stroke();

g.restore();

};

m.hold(t.gust, total, (e, S) => {

const n = Math.floor(e / STEP);

// a cap shorter than the slowest leaf fades whatever is still drifting over the last 900 ms

const cap = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (leafMs - e) / 900));

S.world.push({ z: 70, draw: (g) => {

for (const l of LEAVES) { const f = l.fr[n]; if (!f || f[4] <= 0) continue; leaf(g, f[0], f[1], f[2], f[3], f[4] * cap, l.s, l.col); }

} });

});

// Signal the end the moment the caster is off-screen: BD then removes the token (leave_combat)

// while the leaves keep drifting, so the timeline teardown has no live token to show again.

let goneSignalled = false;

m.hold(t.gone, t.gone + 80, () => { if (!goneSignalled) { goneSignalled = true; oni.fireDone(); } });

await tl.run(T, { total: total + 60, sfx: cfg.sfx || [], onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "See you later" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

// Gadgets — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"totalTimeoutMs":20000,"t":{"glint":380,"toss":680,"land":1330,"back":1330,"total":1930},"sfx":[{"at":380,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Item1.ogg","v":0.35},{"at":680,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGA.wav","v":0.27999999999999997},{"at":1330,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Break.ogg","v":0.27999999999999997}]};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"twinkle":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/Guilty%20Gear%20Strive/webm/twinkle_anim02.webm","w":64,"h":64,"dur":250,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5,"mask":true},"burst":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/Guilty%20Gear%20Strive/webm/burst_anim02.webm","w":682,"h":1024,"dur":300,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5,"mask":true}},"images":{}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.party.zarg-gadgets";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Gadgets]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Gadgets — approved mockup (v8). Zarg steps out 46, three teal twinkles glint at his

// hand, a vial is tossed (650 ms, 160 px arc, 720 deg spin) onto the target, a teal

// GG burst + brightness pop for the infusion; he steps back. The attack's own

// animation plays afterwards as usual. No number (gate null).

// No target: the vial lands 200 px in front of him.

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E } = B;

const t = cfg.t;

const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

const C = TOK.c; const cf = K.feet(tl, 'c');

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 46);

const hand = { x: cf.x + dir * 46 * U + dir * 34 * U, y: cf.y - C.h * 0.45 };

const tk = TG[0] || null;

const dest = tk ? K.mid(tl, tk) : { x: hand.x + dir * 200 * U, y: hand.y };

K.twinkles(m, t.glint, hand, K.tintF(170, 4, 1.3), 3, 10, U);

// the vial: 26 x 38, pale cap over teal liquid, cyan glow

m.hold(t.toss, t.land, (e, S) => {

const k = Math.min(1, e / (t.land - t.toss));

const x = hand.x + (dest.x - hand.x) * k, y = hand.y + (dest.y - hand.y) * k - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * 160 * U;

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const w = 26 * U, h = 38 * U;

g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(k * 4 * Math.PI);

g.shadowColor = '#88ffff'; g.shadowBlur = 10 * U;

const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, -h / 2, 0, h / 2); gr.addColorStop(0, '#cfe7f5'); gr.addColorStop(0.22, '#cfe7f5'); gr.addColorStop(0.22, '#5ad0b0'); gr.addColorStop(1, '#5ad0b0');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath();

if (g.roundRect) g.roundRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h, [6 * U, 6 * U, 12 * U, 12 * U]); else g.rect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h);

g.fill(); g.restore();

} });

});

m.clip('burst', t.land, { x: dest.x, y: dest.y, w: 682 * 0.85 * 0.5 * U, z: 50, add: true, filter: K.tintF(165) });

if (tk) m.tint(t.land, 220, tk, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.6 * (1 - E.outQ(u)));

await tl.run(T, { total: t.total, sfx: cfg.sfx || [], onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Gadgets" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();
props.description:
You can produce infusions and other gadgets on the fly.

Infusions. When you successfully hit one or more targets with an attack, you may spend 2 Inventory Points to produce a special infusion and apply its effect to that attack. If the attack had the multi property, the effect applies to each target. You cannot apply more than one infusion to the same attack; producing and using an infusion are both part of the attack.

  • Cryo / Pyro / Volt: deal 5 extra damage; the attack's damage becomes ice / fire / bolt.
  • Cyclone / Exorcism / Seismic / Shadow: deal 5 extra damage; the attack's damage becomes air / light / earth / dark.
  • Venom: deal 5 extra damage; the attack's damage becomes poison; each creature hit suffers poisoned.
  • Vampire: heal HP equal to half the damage dealt. Single-target attacks only.

// Myrmidon Dance — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"totalTimeoutMs":20000,"kind":"element","hue":28,"sfx":[{"at":0,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Fall.ogg","v":0.385},{"at":900,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Up1.ogg","v":0.35}]};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"twinkle":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/Guilty%20Gear%20Strive/webm/twinkle_anim02.webm","w":64,"h":64,"dur":250,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5,"mask":true},"powerup":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/052_powerup_2.webm","w":508,"h":630,"dur":1200,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.6508}},"images":{}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.party.zarg-myrmidon-dance";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Myrmidon Dance]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const onFeet = (key, at, k, nativeW, filter) => { const f = K.feet(tl, k); m.clip(key, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y - 8 * U, w: nativeW * 0.85 * U, z: 40, filter: filter || '' }); };

if (kind === 'lion') {

onFeet('cure', END, 'c', 700);

total = END + 1133;

} else if (kind === 'unicorn') {

onFeet('heal', END, 'c', 546);

if (TG.length) onFeet('heal', END, TG[0], 546);

total = END + 1400;

} else if (kind === 'ouroboros') {

total = END + 600 + 900 + 600;

const tk = TG[0];

if (tk) {

const from = { x: mid.x, y: mid.y }, to = K.mid(tl, tk);

const ARC = 600, GROW = 900;

const ring = (g, x, y, sx, sy, a) => { g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a; g.translate(x, y); g.scale(sx, sy); g.strokeStyle = '#5fe0c8'; g.lineWidth = 6 * U; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, 27 * U, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); };

// the ring arcs from Zarg to the ally (mockup arc(): ioQ, 70 px high)

m.hold(END, END + ARC, (e, S) => { const k = Math.min(1, e / ARC), q = E.ioQ(k); const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(q * Math.PI) * 70 * U; S.world.push({ z: 55, draw: (g) => ring(g, x, y, 1, 1, 1) }); });

// then widens into a flat loop around them, sinking toward their feet

m.hold(END + ARC, END + ARC + GROW, (e, S) => { const t = E.sine(Math.min(1, e / GROW)); const s = 1 + 1.6 * t; S.world.push({ z: 55, draw: (g) => ring(g, to.x, to.y + 60 * U * t, s, s * 0.35, 1 - t * 0.6) }); });

m.tint(END + ARC + GROW, 220, tk, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.45 * (1 - E.outQ(u)));

}

} else {

onFeet('powerup', END, 'c', 508, 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 55) + 'deg)');

total = END + 1200;

}

await tl.run(T, { total: total + 60, sfx: cfg.sfx || [], onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

scriptSource,

})();

// High Speed — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"totalTimeoutMs":20000,"p":{"amplitude":70,"swings":7,"swingMs":55,"afterimageEveryMs":35,"afterimageFadeMs":240,"disappearFadeMs":120,"hiddenHoldMs":140,"returnFadeMs":520,"blurStrength":12},"sfx":[{"at":0,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind2.ogg","v":0.5}]};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{},"images":{}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.party.high-speed";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][High Speed]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// High Speed — port of the original "AfterImageBlurStep" pseudo script onto

// oni.timeline, same numbers: blur sway +/-70 px x7 (55 ms each), afterimages every

// 35 ms (fade 240), snap to centre, vanish 120, empty beat 140, fade back in 520.

// Fired by the play_animation step at the head of the hs_react chain (conflict start).

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, U, E } = B;

const p = cfg.p; const C = TOK.c; const art = tl.art('c'); const f = K.feet(tl, 'c');

const swingEnd = p.swings * p.swingMs, snapEnd = swingEnd + Math.max(35, Math.floor(p.swingMs * 0.8));

const vanishEnd = snapEnd + p.disappearFadeMs, backAt = vanishEnd + p.hiddenHoldMs, end = backAt + p.returnFadeMs;

const xAt = (e) => {
